newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB 5.4% bond due June 97 traded at 6.0%--traders.
newsitem.headline: NCB 5.4% bond due June 97 traded at 6.0%--traders.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's 5.4 percent five-year bank debenture due June 1997 was traded at 6.0 percent on Monday, traders said.

Yields of NCB's bank debentures with less than a year to go until maturity have been falling recently due to news of the long-term credit bank's restructuring efforts and government support for its reform plans, a brokerage house trader said.
NCB said last week it expects to officially announce its restructuring plan in April.

Although the bank's reform plan has not been officially decided, the sale of real estate and the closure of some branches are among measures which are likely to be considered, Tadao Iwaki, senior managing director of NCB, said last Thursday.
The Ministry of Finance will fully support the drastic restructuring plan being drawn up by NCB, a ministry official said last Thursday.
A two-year NCB debenture due to mature in May 1997 was offered at 7.0 percent last Wednesday, before NCB said it would announce a restructuring plan in April.
